reden: Yes. The audit explicitly reports that Guard._checkTransaction/checkTransaction do not block or validate Safe.setFallbackHandler(address), allowing a renter to set the handler to the rented NFT contract and then call transferFrom/safeTransferFrom via the Safe’s fallback so the token contract sees msg.sender == the Safe, bypassing the guard and stealing the NFT/1155. This is the same mechanism, code path (Guard → Safe FallbackManager → NFT), and impact described in [H-02]. A fix that blocks or validates setFallbackHandler (e.g., disallowing it or ensuring the handler isn’t a rented token) would resolve both.
